notes.title: Update ver.0.4.1
notes.content:
Version 0.4.1 has been released.

[h1]##New Features and Additions[/h1]
[list]
[*]A large number of new “Dungeon Conversations” have been added.
 Each of the 20 personality types now has 180 patterns (60 opening lines, 60 responses, and 60 follow-up reactions), for a total of 3,600 new patterns. Some conversations are exclusive to pairs in a partner or romantic relationship.
From light banter to flirtatious dialogues that feel as if they’ve forgotten they’re in a dungeon, a wide variety of combinations are now possible.
[*] Level reduction when using “Rest” at the GUILD has been removed.
 You can now reset skill points without losing levels, making it easier to experiment with different builds.
[*] A highlighting feature has been added to make it easier to identify members affected by status conditions.
[*] When opening the menu in a dungeon, the name of the current floor will now be displayed at the top of the menu.
[*] Item behavior when inventory limits are exceeded has been adjusted.
When exceeding the item limit, you can now choose to use the item on the spot instead of just discarding it.
[*] UI transitions related to quests at the PUB have been partially adjusted.
 Previously, if there were no available quests on the “ACCEPT” screen or no quests in progress on the “REPORT” screen, a blank list was displayed. This has been changed so the interface will now automatically return to the previous menu in those cases.
[/list]
[h1]## Fix[/h1]
[list]
[*] Experience points are now distributed only among characters who have not yet reached the maximum level.
[*] Fixed an issue where preemptive strike checks during enemy encounters were not working properly.
[*] Fixed a rare issue where unintended text would sometimes appear at the top of the screen when exceeding the item limit.
[*] IAdjusted and corrected some English and Simplified Chinese translations.

Further updates are in the works.
 The previously announced additions of the Monster Encyclopedia and Tutorial Guide are planned for the May update.

Thank you for your continued support of Witch and Lilies!

notes.title: Update ver.0.4.0Update ver.0.4.0
notes.content:
Version 0.4.0 has been released.

[h2]New Additions and Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] A new feature, "Dungeon Conversations," has been added. While moving through the dungeon, party members will randomly engage in conversations.
We are considering adding more conversation patterns in future updates.
[*] The background graphics for the Sixth Layer dungeon have been updated to improve visibility.
[/list]
[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a display issue in the item discard screen.
[*] Fixed an issue where the direction in which dungeon doors opened was inconsistent.
[*] Corrected minor typographical errors.
[/list]
We will continue to update the game. In the next update, we plan to add a Monster Encyclopedia and a Tutorial Guide.
Thank you for your continued support of Witch and Lilies!

notes.title: Update ver.0.3.2
notes.content:
Version 0.3.2 has been released.

[h1]##New Features and Additions[/h1]
[list]
[*] During battles, an aura effect has been added to character portraits when the Kizuna Gauge is full.
[*] Sound effects have been added for the following:[list]
[*] At the start of battles
[*] When buying or selling items at the SHOP
[*] When staying or recovering at the INN
[/list][*] Added post-use messages for certain skills that can be used in dungeons to address the difficulty in determining whether they were used successfully:
[list]
[*] Scout skills: "Vigilance" and "Tactical Retreat"
[*] Necromancer skills: "Entice" and "Exorcism"
[*] Sylvan skill: "Fairy Path"
[/list]
[/list]
[h1]## Fix[/h1]
[list]
[*] Corrected the MP consumption displayed for the Bard's skill "Witch's Final Tribute" in the CUSTOM screen to match the actual MP consumed.
[*] Fixed an issue on the 24th floor where players could proceed without clearing the intended gimmick.
[*] Adjusted an event that occurs at a specific coordinate on the 13th floor based on story progress choices.
(Previously, when certain conditions were met, an event forcibly changed the direction of movement and displayed text at specific coordinates every time. This has been adjusted so that the event only occurs once.)
[*] Improved the description of the passive skill "○○ Mastery," which activates when equipping specific weapons.
Changed "Increases attack power" to clearer descriptions such as "Increases ATK" or "Increases damage under specific conditions."
*Example: "Staff Mastery" increases ATK but does not increase magical damage. 
*Example 2: "Thunder Mastery" does not change stats but increases final damage by Thunder magic.)
[*] Fixed an issue where character names were displayed incorrectly in the SHOP.
[*] Corrected minor typographical errors.
[/list]
We will continue to make improvements to enhance the game.
Additionally, we are currently improving the graphics of the sixth layer. While it may give a different impression compared to the previous version, these changes aim to improve visibility. We plan to release these updates between late November and early December.

Thank you for your continued support of Witch and Lilies.

notes.title: Notice of Update Delay and Apology
notes.content:
Dear Users,

Thank you for your continued support of "Witch and Lilies."

We had planned to release our monthly update as scheduled; however, due to development delays, this month's update will be postponed until next week or later. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience to everyone who has been looking forward to it.

Our team is working hard to deliver an enhanced experience, and we appreciate your patience while we complete this update.

Thank you for your continued support of "Witch and Lilies."

notes.title: Update ver.0.3.1
notes.content:
Version 0.3.1 has been released.
This is a patch to fix a issue that caused the game to become unplayable  specific conditions.

[h1]## Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]We have addressed the issue that caused the game to become unplayable under the following conditions:
[list]
[*]If you return to TOWN after reaching the 11th floor for the first time and exit the game without triggering the event at the GUILD, the event to receive the key item 'The Royal Key' at the GUILD upon reaching the 16th floor does not occur, preventing the door on the 16th floor from being opened.
[/list]o resolve this issue, we have made it so that:
[list]
[*]If you encounter the situation where the event to receive the key item 'The Royal Key' does not occur upon reaching the 16th floor, the key item 'The Royal Key' will automatically be added to your inventory.
[/list]Players who were unable to progress due to this bug will now be able to explore the 16th floor after applying this update.
[/list]
We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience.
Thank you for your continued support of Witch and Lilies.

notes.title: Update ver.0.3.0
notes.content:
Version 0.3.0 has been released.

[h1]##追加された新要素、機能[/h1]
[list]
[*]New Game+ has been added.
[list]
[*]You can now start the story from the beginning while carrying over data from the save file after reaching the ending.
[/list][*]Suspend Save feature has been added.
[list]
[*] It is now possible to suspend the game even within dungeons. When returning to the title from the menu within a dungeon, a suspend save will be performed, allowing you to resume by selecting "Continue" from the title screen.
[/list][*]Various UI animations have been adjusted.
[/list]
[h1]## Balance Adjustments[/h1]
[list]
[*]Adjusted the probability of Random Dates occurring and the likelihood of being selected as the invited party. 
[list]
[*]The higher the affection from the inviter to the invitee, the more likely they are to be chosen.
[/list][*]Adjusted the probability of Jealousy Events occurring.
[/list]
[h1]## Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where the required amount for healing at the INN was not displayed correctly.
[*]Fixed an issue where fleeing was impossible if the player's back was against a wall during random encounters.
[*]Fixed an issue where it was possible to flee even if another enemy symbol was present behind the player during enemy symbol encounters.
[*]Fixed an issue where characters not in the party were displayed as "Null" in the Shop's status display.
[/list]

We will continue to listen to your feedback and work towards making improvements.
Thank you for your continued support of Witch and Lilies.

correct：

誤：Attack ↑ Recovery Amount ↑
正：Attack ↑

incorrect：Attack ↑↑ Afflict Instant Death ↑↑ MP Cost: 21
correct：Attack ↑↑ Afflict Instant Death ↑ MP Cost: 21

incorrect：Attack ↑↑ Stun Chance ↑↑ MP Cost: 12
correct：Attack ↑↑ Stun Chance ↑ MP Cost: 12
[*] Fixed an issue in the Scout’s "Sleep Thrust" skill tree screen where the supplementary description displayed when leveling up to Lv5 was incorrect.
incorrect：Attack ↑↑ Afflict Sleep ↑↑ MP Cost: 12
correct：Attack ↑↑ Afflict Sleep ↑ MP Cost: 12
[*] Fixed an issue in the Scout’s "Confuse Thrust" skill tree screen where the supplementary description displayed when leveling up to Lv5 was incorrect.
incorrect：Attack ↑↑ Afflict Confusion ↑↑ MP Cost: 12
correct：Attack ↑↑ Afflict Confusion ↑ MP Cost: 12
[*] Fixed an issue in the Bestia’s " Thunder Needle" skill tree screen where the supplementary description displayed when leveling up to Lv5 was incorrect.
incorrect：Attack ↑↑ Afflict Instant Death ↑↑ MP Cost: 22
correct：Attack ↑↑ Afflict Instant Death ↑ MP Cost: 22
[*] Fixed the skill description of the passive skill "Bond Gauge Boost."
incorrect：Bond Gauge will fill more easily.
correct：Bond Gauge will fill more easily  during normal attacks.
[*] Fixed the skill description of the passive skill "Affinity Boost."
incorrect：Fondness level will increase more easily.
correct：Fondness level will increase more easily at the end of each battle.
[*] Corrected minor typos.
[/list]

We will continue to listen to your feedback and work towards making improvements.
Thank you for your continued support of Witch and Lilies.

notes.title: Regarding Issues with Update Ver. 0.2.9 and Reverting to Ver. 0.2.8
notes.content:
This is StromatoSoft.

We would like to inform you that an issue causing the game to stop was discovered following the update we released on August 31st. We are currently investigating the cause, but as an emergency measure, we have reverted the game to Ver. 0.2.8. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.

You can now play the game in its Ver. 0.2.8 state.

Once the investigation is complete and the issue is fixed, we plan to release a new update. We kindly ask for your patience in the meantime.

Thank you for your continued support.

notes.title: Update ver.0.2.7
notes.content:
We have released version 0.2.7.

[h1]## Added New Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Reduced the level decrease to 3 when resetting skills during rest.
[*] Adjusted the battle entry animations (transition effects).
[*] Added a feature to acquire multiple skill points at once from the skill tree.
[*] Added a screen shaking effect when allies are defeated and when taking damage.
[*] Adjusted the display to show usable skills at the top when selecting skills to use.
[*] Added a feature to switch characters on the spot when selecting skills from the menu.
[*] Added a feature to start turns automatically with text progression during battles.
[*] Added an auto-battle feature that performs normal attacks automatically.
[*] Added a feature to display enemy names, HP, and status ailments during battles.
[*] Added a feature to display names to distinguish between multiple enemies with the same name appearing in a single battle.
[*] Added voice playback timing for characters in the following situations:
　・When registering a character
　・When leveling up
　・When acquiring a skill
　・When winning a battle
[/list]

[h1]## Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the effects of passive skills that increase stats were not reflected on the status screen.
[*] Fixed an issue where certain equipment combinations caused stat values to become negative.
[*] Fixed the sorting order of active skills on the list when acquired.
[*] Fixed an issue where the status effect boosts from the Scout's active skills "Shock Venom" and "Lethal Strike" were not triggering correctly.
[/list]

We will continue to work on improvements to make the game even better. Thank you for your support of Witch & Lilies.

notes.title: Update ver.0.2.6
notes.content:
We have released version 0.2.6.

[h1]Added New Elements and Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] A battle log feature has been added. You can now view the log of up to 15 turns, including the current turn, during battles.
[*] Added a RESIST display when attacking enemies with a resistant attribute during battles. Additionally, WEAK, CRITICAL, and RESIST will each be displayed in different colors.
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Adjusted the quest list to display up to the maximum of 10 quests without scrolling.
[*] Fixed an issue where a special text is displayed when an item is used with no effect.
[*] Fixed an issue where the recovery dialog was not displaying correctly.
[*] Fixed an issue where the experience required for the next level was not displaying correctly on the status screen.
[*] Fixed an issue where the special text was not displayed when the passive skill "Ambush Awareness" was activated.
[*] Fixed the text that appears when using CHANGE during battle and swapping positions with an empty slot.
[*] Fixed an issue where the damage display position would shift during battles if the formation was changed within a dungeon.
[*] Adjusted the current HP/MP to not exceed the maximum when removing equipment that increases the maximum HP/MP.
[*] Fixed sound effect issues related to item selection in the SHOP.
[/list]

We will continue to make improvements to enhance the game. Thank you for your continued support of Witch and Lilies.

notes.title: Update ver.0.2.4

We have released version 0.2.4

[h1]## Added New Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Inventory capacity is now always displayed.
[*] Added key guides for "Use" and "Discard" in the inventory.
[*] Added a key guide for "Use" for skills outside of battle.
[*] Added a notification feature for new items added to the SHOP.
[*] Added a "New" indicator to the item type selection window and tabs when new items are added to the SHOP.
[/list]
[h1]## Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the quests "If You Stay Close","Supporting Each Other," and "Witch's Scenery" would sometimes not trigger. If you are currently progressing through these quests, please discard and reaccept them.
[*] Fixed the appropriate operation guides to be displayed when switching tabs in the SHOP and INVENTORY screens.
[*] Fixed the central upper message to change when selecting BOOST.
[*] Fixed an issue where the sound effect was playing twice on the INN > STORAGE screen.
[*] Fixed the sound effect to play correctly when switching positions in the FORMATION screen.
[*] Fixed an issue where closing the menu after selecting "EQUIP" in the SHOP would cause you to exit the SHOP.
[*] Fixed an issue where the remaining turn count display for buffs and debuffs in the battle INFO had incorrect maximum values.
[*] Fixed an issue where the bottom status display overlapped with some windows.
[*] Fixed an issue where toggling the menu display in TOWN caused bugs in the bottom status display.
[*] Fixed the appropriate operation guides to be displayed when switching tabs in the INVENTORY screen.
[*] Fixed minor display issues.
[*] Fixed minor typographical errors.
[/list]

We will continue to work on improvements to make the game even better. Thank you for your support of Witch & Lilies.

notes.title: Update ver.0.2.3
notes.content:
We have released version 0.2.3.

[h1]## Added New Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] "CRITICAL" now appears when a critical hit occurs on a monster during battle.
[*] "WEAK" now appears when a weak point attack is executed on a monster during battle.
[*] Text now appears for the following states during battle:
[olist]
[*] When a monster is defeated
[*] When an enemy is inflicted with "Instant Death"
[*] When a party character is defeated
[*] When a party character is inflicted with "Instant Death"
[/olist]
[/list]

[h1]## Balance Adjustments[/h1]
[list]
[*] Improved the performance of passive skills that heal during battle.
   Target skills:
[olist]
[*] Knight: "Life Breath"
[*] Healer: "Magic Breath"
[*] Wizard: "Magic Breath"
[*] Bard: "Vitality Tempo"
[*] Sylvan: "Vitality Breath"
[/olist]
[*] To improve battle tempo, the effects of passive skills that heal during battle will no longer play.
   Target skills:
[olist]
[*] Knight: "Life Breath"
[*] Knight: "Serene Breath"
[*] Healer: "Magic Breath"
[*] Wizard: "Magic Breath"
[*] Bard: "Vitality Tempo"
[*] Bard: "Exorcising Tempo"
[*] Necromancer: "Serene Breath"
[*] Sylvan: "Vitality Breath"
[*] Bestia: "Serene Breath"
[/olist]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where progress could become impossible under certain conditions on the 24th floor.
[*] Fixed an issue where progress could become impossible under certain conditions on the 11th floor. Following this fix, the 11th floor can only be progressed after completing the report event at the Lord's Hall upon reaching the 11th floor.

[*] Fixed an issue where character names would wrap if they exceeded a certain length.
[*] Fixed an issue where HP and MP would not wrap when displayed with four digits.
[*] Fixed an issue where parameter values were obscured by character portraits, making them difficult to see in some cases.
[*] Fixed an issue where the experience points required for the next level were not displayed correctly on the status screen.
[*] Improved the operability of the display monitor selection options in the OPTION menu.
[*] Fixed an issue where the skip display for conversations would overlap with certain character graphics, reducing visibility.
[*] Fixed an issue where unnecessary buttons would appear when opening the credits or licenses.
[*] Fixed minor display issues.
[*] Fixed minor typographical errors.
[/list]

We will continue to work on improvements to make the game even better. Thank you for your support of Witch & Lilies.

notes.title: Update ver.0.2.1
notes.content:
We have released version 0.2.1.

[h2] ##Important Notice[/h2]
We have significantly adjusted the balance of the romance events.
[list]
[*] The dissatisfaction level decreases more when a date is successful.
[*] The increase in dissatisfaction level is less when a jealousy event occurs.
[*] The dissatisfaction level increase is set to 0 when a date fails (indicated by "Seems things didn't go very well...").
[*] Fixed an issue where buffs related to affection and dissatisfaction were not being applied correctly.
[*] Adjusted the attack power of Bond Chase to increase gradually.
[/list]
Additionally, we have made some downward adjustments to the abilities of certain weapons for overall balance. We apologize to all players for any inconvenience caused.
[list]
[*] The weapon "Faceless Sword" had an incorrect ATK increase amount, which has been adjusted downward.
[/list]
We will continue to adjust the overall game balance to improve the gameplay experience based on your feedback.
   
[h2]##New Features Added[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a feature to speed up progress by holding down the confirm button during battles and conversations.
[*] Added an FPS limit setting in the options menu.
[*] Added an effect where the standing illustration of the partner who activated the Bond Buff is displayed.
[/list]

[h2]##Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the quest "Holy Mother Inscriptions" would sometimes not trigger.
[*] Fixed an issue where the quest "Witch's Scenery" would sometimes not trigger.
[*] Corrected errors in the reward descriptions of quest texts.
[*] Fixed a misleading description of the Warrior's skill "Sword Pressure" that suggested it affected "all enemies" during battle. The skill still affects a single enemy only.
[*] Fixed an issue where Unison Charge would disappear during rest.
[*] Fixed an issue where buffs related to affection and dissatisfaction were not being applied correctly.
[*] Fixed an issue where removing a character from the formation at the INN's ORGANIZE section and entering battle would cause the game to become unplayable.
[*] Fixed an issue where canceling during target selection for Unison attacks did not process the cancellation correctly.
[*] Fixed an issue where selecting Boost mode after learning Unison Charge would cause the game to become unplayable.
[*] Adjusted the behavior so that when canceling during target selection in Boost or Unison mode, the mode is properly retained after cancellation.
[*] Corrected minor UI display issues.
[*] Corrected minor text bugs.
[*] Corrected minor map bugs.
[/list]

We will continue to work on improvements to make the game even better. Thank you for your support of Witch & Lilies.

notes.title: Update ver.0.1.4
notes.content:
We have released version 0.1.4.

[h2] Important Notice[/h2]
We have implemented some adjustments to certain skills and weapons to balance the overall game. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause to our players. These changes are necessary to ensure a balanced gameplay experience. We appreciate your understanding.
[list]
[*] The amount of bond gauge increase from Unison Charge has been reduced.
[*] The attack power of offensive Unison skills has been reduced.
[*] The TEC increase value of the weapon "Faceless Staff" was set incorrectly and has been adjusted downwards.
[/list]
We will continue to adjust the overall game balance based on your feedback to enhance the gameplay experience.
   
[h2]Additional Content[/h2]
[list]
[*] We have added new weapons and equipment obtainable from the drop items of certain symbol encounter enemies.
[/list]

[h2]Fix[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where Unison Charge would be removed from the skill list when changing the job of a character with a partner. Characters affected by this issue before this update will have Unison Charge restored after the update.
[*] The quest item name for "Witch's Meal" was incorrectly set, so it has been removed from the delivery target.
[*] Fixed an issue related to the increase in affection and dissatisfaction during romance events.
[/list]

Thank you for your support of Witches and Lilies.

notes.title: Version 0.1.2 Update
notes.content:
[h1][b]Balance Adjustments[/b][/h1]
[list][*]Increased the success rate of date invitations and the likelihood of satisfaction with the date.
[/list]

[h1][b]Fixes[/b][/h1]
[list][*]Fixed an issue where the screen would sometimes switch to windowed mode when changing display settings.
[*] Addressed a problem where the mouse cursor was locked during windowed mode.
[*] Fixed an issue where status was not displayed correctly on the status confirmation screen at the inn.
[*] Corrected a bug where the game did not properly determine victory or defeat after the last character in each faction died due to status ailments or debuffs.
[*] Fixed a bug where voice types would switch when changing formation positions.
[*] Corrected an issue where the "Open Map" function was incorrectly assigned to a key during dungeon operations.
[*] Fixed a bug where the pop-up displayed during formation changes in battle was not showing correctly.
[*] Corrected an issue where the dissatisfaction text was displayed even though dissatisfaction did not actually increase when a date invitation failed.
[*] Fixed a bug where dungeon event flags were not being saved correctly in certain situations.
[*] Fixed the issue where characters in the formation could not act in battle under the following specific conditions:
[*][olist]
[*] When the number of characters in the front row and back row changes in the dungeon, and one side has three members
[*] Moving from the side with more members to the side with fewer members
[*] The destination is the far right (empty slot)
[*] A total party wipe occurs
[/olist]
[*]This also occurs under the following conditions:
[olist]
[*] When returning to town, the rightmost member of the side with three members is dead
[*][list]
[*]1) Returning to the title screen and loading saved data [*]2) Where the rightmost member of the side with three members is dead [*]3) And this character was in the front row if they were previously in the back row, or in the back row if they were previously in the front row [*]4) And still located on the far right.
[/list]
[/olist]
[/list]
